topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation within the context of the course.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and cellular damage through molecular patterns and distinct pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Cellular Dynamics and Systemic Spread of Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular mechanisms that execute, direct, and propagate the active inflammatory response across tissues and the vascular system.

topics.label: Inflammation Resolution, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the processes responsible for shutting down active inflammation, rebuilding damaged tissues, and managing persistent inflammatory challenges.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture on the complement system.
